backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing a cosmetics shop with 50 Gorilla Tag themed items, user balance management (default 100, periodic income via timer), purchase logic, inventory tracking, and an admin code (2807) to grant 50M funds.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that preserves user state (balance and inventory) across canister upgrades by passing through the existing users map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the frontend shop interface update for Gorilla Tag themed cosmetics, listing affected components and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React components, hooks, and styling files describing the shop UI, balance display, purchase flow, admin functionality, and Gorilla Tag themed cosmetics presentation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base layer defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes with warm coral, peach, and rose gold palette avoiding blue/purple tones.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading the React application titled 'Virtual Cosmetics Shop'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component with tab navigation between Shop and Owned Items views, user initialization on mount, header with branding, footer with admin box and caffeine.ai attribution, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminBox.tsx: Discreet admin code input form (opacity 30%, hover 100%) that submits numeric codes to grant funds via the backend admin function.
frontend/src/components/BalanceDisplay.t: Card component displaying user's balance with currency icon, formatted number, gradient styling, and glow effect.
frontend/src/components/CosmeticItem.tsx: Card component for individual cosmetic items showing name, price badge, sparkles icon placeholder, and either a purchase button or 'Already Owned' indicator based on ownership status.
frontend/src/components/OwnedItemsView.t: View displaying all owned cosmetic items in a responsive grid with sparkles placeholders, loading skeletons, and empty state message when no items are owned.
frontend/src/components/PurchaseButton.t: Button component handling item purchases with loading spinner, disabled state for insufficient funds, and shopping bag icon.
frontend/src/components/ShopInterface.ts: Main shop component that displays user balance, available cosmetic items in a responsive grid, and handles loading/error states using React Query hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing identity state and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including balance, items, purchases, and admin functions with automatic cache invalidation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color palette featuring warm coral/peach tones for light mode and rose gold accents for dark mode.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with custom colors using OKLCH format, border radius variables, glow shadows, and animation keyframes for UI components.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features including purchase system, shop interface, admin code (2807), owned items tab, and Gorilla Tag cosmetics theming.
